title: Small-time failure of full distributed null control for constant-coefficient parabolic-transport systems on the circle with interval observation
author: Karine Beauchard; Armand Koenig; Kévin Le Balc’h
difficulty_reason: Holomorphic spectral projections isolate a genuinely hyperbolic branch of the coupled dissipative Fourier symbol.
